subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The perfume she uses has a strong ______.
solution:
The correct answer is: **scent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'The perfume she uses has a strong ______.', the missing word must refer to the smell or aroma which is produced by the perfume.
 
• The correct English word for this context is** 'scent'**. ("सुगन्ध" or "खुशबू")
 
 
• **Example: **The floral scent of her perfume filled the entire room.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'scent'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **sent:** It is the past and past participle of the verb 'send' which in Hindi means (भेजा हुआ)
 
• **scend: **It is a nautical term meaning the upward movement of a ship on a wave. (हलचल)
 
• **cent:** It is a unit of currency in many countries. (सेंट)
